title: Automated High Throughput Qiagen MagAttract HMW DNA Extraction from Mosquitoes
author: Fiona Teltscher
materials: wash buffers from MagAttract HMW DNA kit Qiagen Catalog #6756

Make mastermix of reagents for lysis. Make sure to choose the right size of tube for preparing the mastermix. Calculate the mastermix volumes for the number of samples plus 1 for spare pipetting volume. Volumes per sample are: 200 µL 1X PBS (Phosphate-buffered saline ) ; 20 µL Proteinase K Qiagen Catalog #67563 (Mix by inverting the tube 5 times); 4 µL RNase A Qiagen Catalog #67563 and 150 µL Buffer AL Qiagen Catalog #67563 (mix by inversion)
Prepare wash buffers included in the MagAttract HMW DNA kit Qiagen Catalog #67563 by adding Ethanol to them.

Download the programme onto a computer and transfer it to your KingFisher Apex: MagAttract_HMW_Lawniczak_KingFisher_protocolsio.kfx KingFisher Apex System (Automated DNA purification system, ThermoFisher Scientific, 5400930, https://www.thermofisher.com/order/catalog/product/5400930 )
The software allows you to input batch/lot information for each reagent. This is optional but highly recommended.

Once the KingFisher Apex is finished the plates can be removed as prompted. Elution 1 and 2 for each sample can be combined into the same tube (making sure to use wide-orifice tips). Be careful to combine elution 1 and 2 of the same sample and to not mix up elution 1 and 2 of different samples at this step. Used plates that still have unused wells can be reused in future runs. Either carefully tip out the waste without contaminating unused wells or keep buffers in. If you keep the buffer in the wells make sure to reuse the plates soon after as some of the buffers can crystallise and cause the tip comb to not fit into the well anymore, leading to an error message and a potentially failed run. Mark which wells were used and cover plates with a film, such as Tape Pads Qiagen Catalog #19570 . When reusing plates that still have used buffers from previous runs in some wells make sure you only run the same programme with the same volume to avoid spillage in the machine.

steps.title: Prepare dry ice storage box
steps.instruction: Set up an open insulated box filled with dry ice to hold sample tubes while performing steps 2‑4.

steps.title: Add mastermix to LoBind tubes
steps.instruction: For each sample, pipette 374 µL of the mastermix (prepared in step 2) into a new 1.5 mL DNA LoBind tube.

steps.title: Homogenize mosquito sample
steps.instruction: Using clean forceps, remove the mosquito from its preservation liquid (if present) by lightly touching a clean tissue to blot excess liquid, then place the mosquito into the mastermix tube. Insert a sterile autoclavable pestle and grind, smash, twist and squash the tissue against the tube wall for 00:01:00 until no recognizable body parts remain, only flakes. Place the tube in a rack on the bench. Clean the forceps with 70‑100 % ethanol after use.

steps.title: Briefly centrifuge tubes
steps.instruction: Spin all tubes briefly in a minicentrifuge (or similar) to collect the liquid at the bottom of each tube.

steps.title: Incubate samples at 25 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes at 25 °C (or at room temperature if a heat block is unavailable) for 02:00:00.

steps.title: Unpack KingFisher plates
steps.instruction: Unpack nine KingFisher DeepWell 96‑well plates (barcoded or non‑barcoded, sterile or standard). While the samples incubate, keep the plates covered with clean wipes or load them onto the instrument to avoid contamination.

steps.title: Fill plates with reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the following reagents and dispense the indicated volumes into the corresponding wells of each plate (fill only the wells you will use).

substeps.instruction: Plate type: KingFisher 96 deep‑well plate and 96 tip comb for deep‑well magnets (catalog numbers 95040450 and 97002534). No liquid added – this is the tip‑comb plate.
Elution 2 plate (catalog 95040450): add 200 µL Buffer AE (Qiagen, catalog #19077).
Elution 1 plate (catalog 95040450): add 200 µL Buffer AE (Qiagen, catalog #19077).
NFW Wash plate (catalog 95040450): add 500 µL Nuclease‑Free Water (Qiagen, catalog #129114).
PE Wash 2 plate (catalog 95040450): add 700 µL Buffer PE (Qiagen, catalog #19065).
PE Wash 1 plate (catalog 95040450): add 700 µL Buffer PE (Qiagen, catalog #19065).
MW1 Wash 2 plate (catalog 95040450): add 700 µL Buffer MW1 (contributed by users, catalog #67563).
MW1 Wash 1 plate (catalog 95040450): add 700 µL Buffer MW1 (contributed by users, catalog #67563).
Sample plate (catalog 95040450): add 15 µL MagAttract Suspension G (Qiagen, catalog #67563) and 280 µL Buffer MB (contributed by users, catalog #67563).

steps.title: Start KingFisher and select protocol
steps.instruction: Power on the KingFisher Apex, attach the 96‑deep‑well magnet head and the appropriate tip comb, and select the correct DNA‑extraction protocol. Perform 1 hour of UV decontamination either before or after the run.

steps.title: Load reagent plates onto instrument
steps.instruction: Place all prepared plates (except the sample plate) onto the KingFisher Apex in the designated slots.

steps.title: Add incubated samples to sample plate
steps.instruction: After the 02:00:00 incubation, transfer each sample into the corresponding well of the sample plate using wide‑orifice pipette tips, recording which sample is placed in which well.

steps.title: Run extraction program
steps.instruction: Load the sample plate (including the samples) onto the instrument, start the program, and allow it to run for approximately 00:50:00.

steps.title: Store DNA and assess quality
steps.instruction: Store the extracted high‑molecular‑weight gDNA at 4 °C. Quantify DNA using either the Qubit® dsDNA HS Assay Kit (Thermo Fisher, catalog #Q32854) or the Quant‑iT™ PicoGreen™ dsDNA Assay Kit (Thermo Fisher, catalog #P11496). Assess DNA quality with the Femto Pulse gDNA 165 kb Analysis Kit (Agilent Technologies, catalog #FP-1002-0275).
